name: Acid Rain
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a flask of acid)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 20-ft. radius cylinder, 40 ft. high, which must connect to the ground
Duration see text
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Caustic rain pours down in the area for 1 round. All creatures beginning their turn in or entering the area take 6d6 acid damage, no save. For 1 round per caster level, the ground is muddy or slick causing it to be difficult terrain. Any creature that moves more than 10 feet in the difficult terrain takes 1d4 acid damage.
